Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 8359 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Hounslow's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 2.3222 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (93% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 12.0666 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (99% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by plain 2021 resident population (288,200) — no separate workday/footfall figure exists for Hounslow in the ONS's 2011 workday-population release (the most recent one published), so no correction is applied here (ratio 1.0) rather than guessing one. This means Hounslow's score may be slightly overstated relative to boroughs where a real commuter/footfall correction could be applied — see methodology. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.

Frequently asked questions

Is Hounslow safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Hounslow as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 8359 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Hounslow safe at night?

Hounslow's night score is roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Hounslow's rating based on?

8359 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Hounslow's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06) — refreshed automatically every month, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
